description: This file defines a command handler class CreateGLClosureCommandHandler responsible for processing commands to create general ledger (GL) closures within the Apache Fineract accounting module. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface, uses annotations for dependency injection and command type specification, and delegates the creation operation to the GLClosureWritePlatformService.

classes.name: CreateGLClosureCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class implementing command handling for GL closure creation, using dependency injection for the write platform service, and marking method processCommand as transactional.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes a JSON command to create a GL closure by delegating to the write platform service.
